models.title: Quoted (inside) bid-ask spread
models.summary: Quoted spread as the ask price minus the bid price; for a book, the lowest ask minus the highest bid.

relationship.original_equation: Quoted spread = ask - bid (inside spread = lowest ask - highest bid)
relationship.locator: PDF: LM6 Trading Costs and Electronic Markets, effective/quoted spread formulas, printed pp. 415-416 (PDF pp. 425-426)
relationship.translation_notes: Currency units on both inputs and output (unit 1 by pack convention); decimals throughout.

variables.domain: Positive finite price not above ask

variables.definition: Quoted bid-ask spread, in currency units

assumptions: Both quotes from the same market snapshot (inside spread uses best ask/best bid).
limitations: Quoted spread only; price improvement, size effects, and market impact are captured by effective-spread siblings, not here.

sources.locator: The bid-ask spread is the difference between the bid and the ask prices. The effective spread is two times the difference between the trade price and the midquote price before the trade occurred. VWAP compares average fill prices to average market prices; implementation shortfall captures all explicit and implicit costs.
sources.evidence: Page states the identical spread definitions (quoted spread as bid-ask difference; effective spread as twice the trade-minus-midquote distance) and the VWAP/implementation-shortfall benchmark roles.

models.title: Effective spread for a buy order
models.summary: Buy-side effective spread as twice the trade price minus the order-entry midquote.

relationship.original_equation: Effective spread (buy) = 2 x (Trade price - Midpoint of market at order entry)
relationship.locator: PDF: LM6 Trading Costs and Electronic Markets, effective/quoted spread formulas, printed pp. 415-416 (PDF pp. 425-426)
relationship.translation_notes: Midquote = (ask+bid)/2 at order-entry time; x2 converts the per-share cost into the spread statistic. Currency units (unit 1); decimals.

variables.definition: Ask price when the order was entered, in currency units
Bid price when the order was entered, in currency units
Buy-side effective spread, in currency units

assumptions: Quotes are those prevailing at order-entry time, not at fill time.
limitations: Per-fill estimate; splitting large orders across time (market impact, delay) is not captured here - see implementation-shortfall discussion deferred in gaps. Price improvement yields spreads below quoted; outside-quote fills yield spreads above quoted.

sources.title: Effective Spreads & VWAP (AnalystPrep CFA Level II notes)
sources.locator: Effective spread cost estimate = Trade size x (Trade price - (Bid+Ask)/2) for buys (reversed for sells); the effective spread is obtained by multiplying by two. Worked buy oracles: X: 6,000x(12.22-12.20) = 120; sell oracles: X: 6,000x(12.225-12.19) = 210, Y: 6,000x(12.225-12.18) = 270. VWAP = sum(Price x Volume)/sum(Volume): 121,060/8,000 = 15.13. VWAP cost estimate = Trade size x (Trade VWAP - VWAP benchmark) for buys (reversed for sells).
sources.evidence: Page states both directional formulas with independent worked oracles reproducing the PDF's forms: per-share effective spreads (buy X: 2x(12.22-12.20) = 0.04), sell costs (X 210, Y 270), VWAP 15.13, and both VWAP cost-estimate branches.
sources.redistribution: Short original paraphrase and single-formula transcription only; no extended quotation

models.title: Effective spread for a sell order
models.summary: Sell-side effective spread as twice the order-entry midquote minus the trade price.

relationship.original_equation: Effective spread (sell) = 2 x (Midpoint of market at order entry - Trade price)
relationship.locator: PDF: LM6 Trading Costs and Electronic Markets, effective/quoted spread formulas, printed pp. 415-416 (PDF pp. 425-426)
relationship.translation_notes: Mirror of the buy branch with the distance reversed. Currency units (unit 1); decimals. Example 1 sell oracles: 2x(10.18-10.15) = 0.06 (price improvement beats quoted 0.12); 2x(10.165-10.11) = 0.11 (equals quoted); 2x(10.12-10.01) = 0.22 (walked the book, exceeds quoted 0.14).

variables.definition: Ask price when the order was entered, in currency units
Bid price when the order was entered, in currency units
Sell-side effective spread, in currency units

assumptions: Quotes are those prevailing at order-entry time (average fill price used for multi-price fills, per Example 1 third trade).
limitations: Per-fill estimate; same large-order limitations as the buy branch.
